While its construction was going on, the intimation to move to Pothencode was received. Along with it, a couple of words were given: "You should chant this. Chant and become strong." Two lines were given for two people. Before completing this, while sitting at Kadakkavoor railway station at dawn to go to Chirayinkeezhu with Kadalikkad Gopalan Master, some boys returning from a festival came that way. Some of them booed and made noises, and when I held on and got into the train, someone came, struck me a blow, grabbed me by the towel, and dragged me. However, on that day, I had suffered a lapse in memory. The words received through the divine voice had instructed me not to step outside for three days. For the first two days, I did not step outside. On that day, forgetting this, I went out. It was three days after this that I happened to come here, based on the intimation not to stay in a place where two people gather. When I left Varkala and came here, a rumor was spread that boys who were hostile to me had beaten and chased me away. When I was not seen, people believed it. They were never convinced of the truth either. Nine months after coming here, a word was received from the light that anything should be done only after two and a half years. However, after nine months, an intimation was received from the Trinity and the Rishis under the Trinity stating that treatment for illnesses could be done. It was started. The results started appearing double than before. Suddenly, a situation arose where about three hundred people would come and go daily. Within three weeks, the situation was such that sixty patients could lie inside and get cured. There were no buildings or anything else here then. The patients and visitors used to lie on the bare grass. They were exposed to both dew and sun alike. Out of dedication, they disregarded all this. Suddenly, like before, it became difficult to conclude all this within three months.

In the meantime, an intimation was received to chant the name that was given to us earlier. When that name was prayed and resolutions were made with it, all the undertaken diseases were cured. Again, an intimation came to remain motionless for three and a half years. In accordance with this intimation, I remained silent. I was informed to undertake a journey, and I travelled. There were four of us at that time. We also took a child along. It is known that this child had received a vision earlier. We stayed here for a few days. Until then, none of those who were communicating through visions were taken along. The reason for not taking them was the feeling that, like before, some errors were occurring due to the obstruction of certain Devas. Meanwhile, it became evident that what was coming from these Devas was wrong. A feeling arose that this was no longer needed! What is received from the Light is sufficient. I firmly decided not to accept anything of this sort. This was also spoken through a divine voice. Finally, a correction was received over three weeks in the nature of a vision of Krishna. That has remained true in experience to this day. Before reaching all the temples during the journey, this ten-year-old child would visibly receive the deities and signs present there. Thus, we went up to Madras. We accomplished more than intended within three months and returned. Along with returning like that, the location for the Kallar ashram was found and it was established. Many things happening today were foretold right there. Since it is impossible to reveal any of that now, it is not being done.

After that, it is understood that the intimation received from 1973 to 1979 is almost entirely filled with truth and greatness. It can be stated here that a few things in that intimation need to be clarified for this human world. There are two paths for the worship practices of Hindus. One is the path of Devas and Devis (deities) and the other is the path of the lineage of Rishis. The status of Devas and Devis belongs to the Treta and Dwapara Yugas, and the path of the Guru is for humans to experience and exhaust through births all the mistakes they have committed in various periods and attain liberation. The other is that the souls who have lived with the path of merging with God, having taken birth in this Kali Yuga, standing as a Guru to human beings and indeed all living creatures engulfed in Kali, will grant liberation to those who need it; and other pious souls will get rebirth in the approaching Satya Yuga, living on earth like Devas, attaining the fulfillment of birth in a way that allows change according to other yugas—it can be understood that this is the path maintained by the Guru lineage according to the law of Manu.

Therefore, the future intention for the remaining period of Kali Yuga is to advise humans according to the directions of the Gurus belonging to this Manu lineage, convince them about the luminous matters beyond this Trinity system, and guide them on that path to liberation or transform them into souls eligible for the positions of the aforementioned Acharyas. What has been said is only a few brief portions of the intimation received from 1973 to 1979. The parts of karma performed accordingly and the experiential parts realized through it will be discussed later. Those are matters with certain directions and intentions. They cannot be stated hastily like this.
